komainau.name: Mainau Island
komainau.slogan: A whole island in bloom, moored in the Lake.
komainau.line: Swedish count Lennart Bernadotte took over the island in 1932 and turned it into the flower garden it is today.

koimperia.name: Imperia
koimperia.slogan: She turns once every four minutes and never looks away.
koimperia.line: Erected clandestinely in 1993, the 9-metre, 18-tonne statue holds two tiny men resembling a pope and an emperor.

komuenster.name: Konstanz Minster
komuenster.slogan: Where a pope was crowned and a council ruled Europe.
komuenster.line: Martin V was enthroned here in 1417, ending the Great Schism during the Council of Constance.

koburgmeersburg.name: Meersburg Castle
koburgmeersburg.slogan: Germany's old lakeside fortress, still lived in.
koburgmeersburg.line: Considered one of the oldest inhabited castles in Germany, its central tower may date to the 7th century.

kominster.name: Reichenau Minster
kominster.slogan: Monks' island, a thousand years of quiet craft.
kominster.line: Founded by Bishop Pirmin in 724, the Reichenau abbey island became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2000.
